description.html: Coconut coir in a 5-liter pack is one of the most popular natural terrarium substrates. Made from coconut husks, this substrate holds moisture very well, which makes it ideal for tropical and forest reptile species that need higher humidity - crested geckos, chameleons, day geckos and many frog species. Coconut coir is a safe substrate because it does not cause problems if the animal accidentally swallows small amounts. It is naturally resistant to mold and bacteria and contains no harmful chemicals. It can be used on its own or combined with sphagnum moss for extra moisture retention. For bioactive terrariums, coconut coir is an excellent base to which leaves, bark and cleanup crews can be added.
